Free · 100 cards

Deep questions for couples

Deep talk instead of “so, how was your day?”: 100 deep questions about what shaped you, what scares you and what you want. Draw a card, take your time, and ask a follow-up before you tap next.

Deep Questions1 / 100

What part of you do people most often get wrong, and do you ever let them?

Take your time. Answer, then ask why.

Tip: arrow keys and swiping work too.

How to play

  1. Pick a quiet moment: on the couch at night, on a walk or on a video call.
  2. One of you reads the card and answers first. Then the other.
  3. Ask “why?” or “since when?”. The second answer is usually the more honest one.
  4. Three to five cards are plenty for one evening. Don't want to answer? Draw the next one.

100 deep questions for couples

Who you are

  1. What part of you do people most often get wrong, and do you ever let them?
  2. When do you feel most like a fraud?
  3. If you took away your job, your city and your friends, what would still be unmistakably you?
  4. Which emotion do you find hardest to show, and who taught you to hide it?
  5. When were you the bravest you've ever been, and did anyone notice?
  6. What part of you only comes out with certain people?
  7. What do you do to feel in control when everything feels out of control?
  8. When did you last surprise yourself?
  9. Who are you when no one needs anything from you?
  10. What are you still trying to prove, and to whom?

Childhood and family

  1. Which family rule did you swear you'd never repeat, and which have you repeated anyway?
  2. What did you have to figure out on your own as a kid that someone should have explained to you?
  3. What's a moment from your childhood you've never told anyone because it seemed too small?
  4. What did you need as a teenager that you didn't get, and do you still look for it?
  5. What did your family never talk about?
  6. What did your parents do right that you only understand now?
  7. When you think of home as a child, which smell, sound or room comes up first?
  8. What did you pretend to understand as a child so the adults wouldn't worry?
  9. What did you get praised for as a child, and are you still chasing that praise?
  10. When did you first feel you had to earn love?

Fears and vulnerability

  1. What are you afraid people would think if they saw you at your worst?
  2. Which fear has made more of your decisions than you'd like to admit?
  3. What have you never cried about but probably should have?
  4. What would you be most afraid to lose, apart from people?
  5. What's the loneliest you've ever felt in a room full of people?
  6. What kind of failure would feel unbearable to you, and why that one?
  7. Which part of you do you think is too much for other people?
  8. When you're anxious, what story does your mind tell you?
  9. What makes you feel safe, really safe?
  10. What do you assume people think of you when you walk into a room?

Love

  1. What did you think love would feel like before you actually felt it?
  2. What's the difference, for you, between being loved and being understood?
  3. What do you think you owe the people you love?
  4. What kind of love did you only recognise years later?
  5. What do you think makes love last, now that you've seen some of it end?
  6. What's harder for you: giving love or receiving it?
  7. How has your idea of romance changed as you've grown up?
  8. What do you need to hear when you doubt that you're enough for me?
  9. Which love that ended taught you something you still use today?
  10. What does trust feel like in your body?

The two of us

  1. What are we still learning about each other, even now?
  2. Which of our habits do you hope we never lose, and which do you hope we outgrow?
  3. How have I changed you without trying?
  4. When were you most proud to be us?
  5. What do you love about us that you're almost afraid to say out loud, in case you jinx it?
  6. Where do you think we're too careful with each other?
  7. Which question do you hope I'll ask you someday?
  8. What is our relationship quietly teaching you?
  9. If our relationship were a house, which room would need the most care right now?
  10. What part of me do you think the world doesn't get to see?
  11. What do you hope I never stop doing?
  12. What have we come through together that you're quietly proud of?
  13. What do you want our love to look like when we're old?

Conflict and honesty

  1. Which of our arguments have you thought about long after it ended?
  2. How do you know when you're ready to make up?
  3. What's harder for you to say: 'I'm sorry' or 'I'm hurt'?
  4. What truth have you softened so much that it stopped being true?
  5. Which topic do you think we avoid because we're afraid of the answer?
  6. What have you forgiven me for without telling me?
  7. What does respect look like when we disagree?

Values and meaning

  1. What do you believe that most people around you don't?
  2. What does a good life mean to you, with money out of the picture?
  3. Which of your values would you never compromise, not even for me?
  4. What did you once think was important that now seems small?
  5. When did you last feel awe?
  6. Is there anything you consider sacred?
  7. What does success mean to you now, compared to five years ago?
  8. Does everything happen for a reason, or do we give it reasons afterwards?
  9. What do you think is worth suffering for?
  10. What do you think we're here for?

The past and growing

  1. Which decision would you make differently, knowing what you know now?
  2. Which chapter of your life did you rush through?
  3. Which door did you close that you still sometimes stand in front of?
  4. Which year of your life changed you the most, and how?
  5. What did the hardest thing that ever happened to you also give you?
  6. Which of your habits is left over from a time when you needed it?
  7. What do you regret not saying to someone?
  8. What are you learning right now that you didn't expect to have to learn?
  9. Which mistake are you grateful for?
  10. When did you last feel like you were becoming someone new?

The future and time

  1. If you knew you had one year left, what would you stop doing tomorrow?
  2. What are you building that will outlast you?
  3. What would you want to have forgiven before the end?
  4. What do you hope you'll finally understand when you're old?
  5. What do you want to be brave enough to try while you still can?
  6. What do you want to experience with me that we haven't even talked about yet?
  7. What are you putting off as if you had all the time in the world?
  8. What would you want to tell your future self on a hard day?
  9. Which future are you afraid of that you've never mentioned?
  10. Do you think about death more often than you let on?

Wishes and dreams

  1. What do you want that you feel you're not allowed to want?
  2. What dream have you never said out loud because it sounded silly?
  3. What makes you come alive, every single time?
  4. Which talent of yours have you never given a real chance?
  5. What do you miss that you've never actually had?
  6. What do you secretly hope I'll ask you to do with me someday?
  7. Which place in the world feels like it belongs to you, and why?
  8. What do you daydream about when you're bored?
  9. What does 'enough' look like for you?
  10. If today were the start of a new chapter, what would it be called?

These are 100 of the 200 cards in the Deep Questions deck. You get all 200 in the app, 15 per round.
